summary_en: Final dividend for FY2026/6 raised ¥10/share to ¥46/share (from ¥36 prior forecast). Combined with interim dividend ¥32/share, full-year dividend ¥78/share (prior forecast ¥68/share). Subject to approval at annual shareholder meeting scheduled 29 September 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding modification (dividend increase) of FY2026/6 final dividend forecast
translation_en_brief: Anabuki Kosan announced an increase to its FY2026/6 final dividend forecast on 12 August 2026. The final dividend per share is being raised by ¥10 from the previously forecast ¥36 to ¥46. Combined with the interim dividend of ¥32 per share (already paid), the full-year dividend for FY2026/6 is now ¥78 per share, compared to the prior annual forecast of ¥68 per share. The company noted that this increase reflects strong earnings performance and improved financial position in the period, allowing for greater shareholder return within its stated policy of balancing continuous profit distribution with maintenance of internal reserves and financial flexibility. The modification requires approval at the ordinary general shareholders' meeting scheduled for 29 September 2026.
